title: Cordycepin ameliorates spaceflight-induced osteoporosis by preventing BMSCs oxidative stress and senescence via interacting with PI3K p110alpha and regulating PI3K/Akt/FOXO3 signalling.
authors: Zhai, Yu; Zhang, Yuyao; Xu, Kexin; Wang, Tianling; Zhiqun Bian; Qu, Langfan; Wu, Feng; Hu, Zhilei; Chang, Xian; Li, Haiyin; Zhang, Chao; Li, Changqing; Shi, Chunmeng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究虫草素通过PI3K/Akt/FOXO3信号通路缓解太空飞行诱导的骨质疏松，核心是药物-蛋白相互作用，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，且无AI/物理模拟方法。
abstract: Spaceflight-induced osteoporosis (SFOP) is a detrimental healthcare consequence during spaceflight. Weightlessness and ionizing radiation were main environmental factors that contribute to SFOP, especially in the manned deep space voyages. However, currently there is scarce effective method to treat SFOP. This study aims at discovering the role and mechanism of cordycepin (COR) in treating SFOP. A combined ionizing radiation and tail suspension (IR/IS) model is constructed in mice to simulate SFOP. COR injection exhibits certain dose-dependent therapeutic effects including better imageological bone index and improved histological bone regeneration in treating SFOP, which is most prominent at a dose of 20 mg/kg. A combined radiation and microgravity (R/M) model is established to treat BMSCs in vitro. 10 muM COR alleviates oxidative stress and cellular senescence of BMSCs. Through high-throughput sequencing, molecular docking and microscale thermophoresis (MST), we reveal a novel mechanism that COR interacts with p110alpha subunit in PI3K isoform alpha (PI3Kalpha) and inhibits PI3K kinase activity, which then regulates the PI3K/Akt/FOXO3 signalling. To elevate the bioavailability of COR in the SFOP treatment, a BMSCs-targeted delivery system that uses exosomes (Exos) modified with BMSC-affinity peptide E7 (E7-Exos) is constructed and loaded with COR. E7-Exos loaded COR reduces the dosage of COR to 5 mg/kg while enhancing the therapeutic effect than using 20 mg/kg COR alone in treating SFOP. In conclusion, COR shows promise as a potential agent in SFOP therapy.
abstract_zh: 太空飞行诱导的骨质疏松症（SFOP）是太空飞行期间一种有害的健康后果。失重和电离辐射是导致SFOP的主要环境因素，尤其是在载人深空航行中。然而，目前缺乏有效的方法来治疗SFOP。本研究旨在发现虫草素（COR）在治疗SFOP中的作用及机制。在小鼠中构建了电离辐射与尾部悬吊（IR/IS）联合模型以模拟SFOP。COR注射表现出一定的剂量依赖性治疗效果，包括改善影像学骨指数和促进组织学骨再生，在20 mg/kg剂量下效果最为显著。建立了辐射与微重力（R/M）联合模型以在体外处理骨髓间充质干细胞（BMSCs）。10 μM COR减轻了BMSCs的氧化应激和细胞衰老。通过高通量测序、分子对接和微量热泳动（MST），我们揭示了一种新机制，即COR与PI3Kα亚型中的p110α亚基相互作用并抑制PI3K激酶活性，进而调节PI3K/Akt/FOXO3信号通路。为提高COR在SFOP治疗中的生物利用度，构建了一种使用经BMSC亲和肽E7修饰的外泌体（E7-Exos）的BMSCs靶向递送系统，并负载COR。负载COR的E7-Exos将COR剂量降至5 mg/kg，同时在治疗SFOP中增强了治疗效果，优于单独使用20 mg/kg COR。总之，COR在SFOP治疗中显示出作为潜在药物的前景。
